name: Do you see God?
content: Close your eyes & dunk your head. Do you see God?
Now take this pill and relax. Do you see God?
Make the pill bigger to swallow. You climb a mountain and there is a cave. Do you see God?
I am going to fucking kill you. Close your eyes. Do you see God?
All you see as light is [shrouded] white. Do you see God?
I turn the lights off and you can’t see shit. Do you see God?
They say when you die for what feels like seven minutes you replay the best moments of life. Do you see God?
To numb the pain Miss Anesthesia puts you under. Do you see God?
*Inspired by Debotar Jonmo by Shibram Chakraborty*
